oracleScope: Packaged programs use analyzer-authorized destructive ownership only. Stale-alias and post-activation reservation-observer snapshots and nonzero entered-borrow states are independently exercised by local runtime proofs, not achieved by copying linear ownership in a package consumer.
availability: All listed fields are implemented and always available. Tracing does not disable accounting. Zero means a real gauge, count or invariant, not an unsupported measurement.
unreviewedScope: Other owner, prepared, retention, layout and trace schemas and the complete API/lifecycle/performance/platform/release inventory remain mandatory.

schemas.scope: Explicit application admissions within one immutable native-backing budget domain, not ordinary allocator admissions, CLR heap size or RSS.
schemas.consistency: One existing domain gate covers the complete snapshot; independent reservation/unique captures are not part of that transaction.
schemas.resetPolicy: No reset. Current obligations decrease only on activation or completed resource return; lifetime peaks, histories and retained optional ledger survive cleanup.
schemas.historyOverflow: Histories saturate at Int64.MaxValue; a further event marks the budget's sticky HistoryOverflowed. Current gauges and peaks stay exact and cleanup cannot be blocked by history saturation.

fields.name: BudgetId
fields.definition: Positive immutable budget lineage, not an address or ownership authority.
fields.overflow: Budget identity cannot wrap; exhaustion rejects new construction.

fields.name: CapacityBytes
fields.definition: Immutable nonnegative limit on committed plus reserved native backing extents for the whole domain, not just this optional ledger.
fields.overflow: Checked inputs and subtraction-based admission preserve signed maximum.

fields.name: OutstandingReservationCount
fields.definition: Pending/prepared producer or terminal-cleanup obligations, including zero length; activation and actual completed return remove one.
fields.overflow: Explicit Int64 maximum guard rejects new admission before wrap.

fields.name: PeakOutstandingReservationCount
fields.definition: Recorded maximum simultaneous outstanding obligations; never reconstructed from successful event histories.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum of guarded outstanding gauge.

fields.name: PendingBytes
fields.definition: Admitted application extents not yet committed to backing; backend preparation failure retains them for retry.
fields.overflow: Exact nonnegative subset of budget reservation bytes bounded by capacity.

fields.name: PeakPendingBytes
fields.definition: Maximum simultaneously pending application extents, retained after preparation or cancellation.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum bounded by domain capacity.

fields.name: PreparedUnpublishedBytes
fields.definition: Actual prepared backing still governed by an unactivated reservation, including failed consumed cleanup; activation removes this subset without freeing backing.
fields.overflow: Exact nonnegative subset of committed backing bounded by capacity.

fields.name: PeakPreparedUnpublishedBytes
fields.definition: Recorded maximum simultaneous prepared unpublished extent; survives activation, cancellation and failure cleanup.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum bounded by capacity.

fields.name: AdmittedReservationCount
fields.definition: Successful producer permission publications, including zero length; not ordinary backing acquisitions or alias copies.
fields.overflow: Saturating lifetime history.

fields.name: RejectedReservationCount
fields.definition: Application requests refused before metadata acquisition and production because the full declared extent did not fit; invalid arguments and backend failures are distinct.
fields.overflow: Saturating history; refusal remains nonallocating.

fields.name: ControlPreparationFailureCount
fields.definition: Failed control, ledger, accounting or identity preparation before native reservation publication; no fictitious native allocation.
fields.overflow: Saturating history with unchanged native gauges.

fields.name: BackingPreparationCount
fields.definition: Actual completed backing preparation, including zero-length readiness; repeated preparation of ready storage adds no event.
fields.overflow: Saturating history independent of backing ownership.

fields.name: BackingPreparationFailureCount
fields.definition: Failed backend or post-acquisition observation attempts; an observation failure can coexist with genuinely prepared backing.
fields.overflow: Saturating history without losing retry permission.

fields.name: BackendAllocationFailureCount
fields.definition: Only NativeAllocationFailedException outcomes within backing preparation, not metadata or observation failures.
fields.overflow: Saturating history; exact permission charge is preserved or explicitly returned.

fields.name: ActivationCount
fields.definition: Complete initialization and final cancellation check successfully transfer the same control to unique authority; no extra backing charge.
fields.overflow: Saturating history, exact obligation removed once.

fields.name: CancelledReservationCount
fields.definition: Explicit cancellation/disposal whose pending or prepared resource actually returned; a failed return receives no credit.
fields.overflow: Saturating history cannot prevent cleanup.

fields.name: InitializationFailureCount
fields.definition: Non-cancellation failure after entering the producer, including incomplete writes, recorded once before terminal cleanup.
fields.overflow: Saturating history preserves original failure classification.

fields.name: AbandonedReservationCount
fields.definition: Abandoned reservation resources actually returned by finalization, not merely collected references or scheduled attempts.
fields.overflow: Saturating history does not interfere with exact release.

fields.name: ReturnFailureCount
fields.definition: Actual failed reservation resource returns; pending borrowed activity without an attempt and later unique returns are not reservation failures.
fields.overflow: Saturating history with surviving obligation.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.definition: Sticky whole-budget history exactness flag shared with ordinary budget events; reaching maximum exactly does not alone set it.
fields.overflow: Monotonic until domain ends; exact gauges and authority never saturate.

fields.name: LedgerFieldBytes
fields.definition: Fifteen Int64 fields (120 bytes) while the optional ledger is retained, otherwise zero. Excludes CLR headers, padding and referenced objects; remains after all obligations end.
fields.overflow: Fixed structural constant; independently reflection-checked.

fields.name: BudgetAdmissionFieldBytes
fields.definition: One reference and two Int64 admission-specific fields on every budget, separate from optional ledger and other budget fields.
fields.overflow: Fixed architecture-dependent representation, not measured CLR heap size.

schemas.scope: One specialized acquisition-time control observed through one value binding; observations remain available on stale and returned non-default values without reopening authority.
schemas.consistency: Individual control fields are sampled without adding a lock or lifetime pin. Quiescent captures reconcile; concurrent transition captures are not a transaction or later authorization.
schemas.resetPolicy: No reset; declared extent, lineage, successful preparation marker and peaks persist after terminal return. Activation changes cleanup responsibility, not control identity.
schemas.historyOverflow: Control failure histories saturate with a sticky flag; authority versions are checked non-wrapping and successful moves are derived exactly.

fields.name: BudgetId
fields.definition: Original budget lineage retained after backing return.
fields.overflow: Immutable non-wrapping budget identity.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.definition: Stable specialized control/backing-owner lineage, preserved through move and activation.
fields.overflow: Owner construction checks exhaustion before permission publication.

fields.name: BindingVersion
fields.definition: Version carried by this observed value, unchanged when another value moves control authority.
fields.overflow: Published versions never wrap.

fields.name: AuthorityVersion
fields.definition: Sampled current control version, including later unique movement; not permission conferred by capture.
fields.overflow: Checked destructive movement consumes on exhaustion rather than wrapping.

fields.name: BindingIsActive
fields.definition: This version owns an idle pending/prepared producer permission with a return obligation. Activated or terminal authority is never permission.
fields.overflow: Exact boolean independent of histories.

fields.name: Outcome
fields.definition: Real disposition of pending, prepared, activated, cancelled, initialization/preparation failure, abandonment or authority exhaustion. A terminal failure may still need cleanup.
fields.overflow: Finite lifecycle, no reset or resurrection.

fields.name: DeclaredLength
fields.definition: Immutable exact eventual initialized element count, not capacity inferred from current backing.
fields.overflow: Nonnegative Int32 checked before admission.

fields.name: RequestedBytes
fields.definition: Immutable declared length times unmanaged element size, retained after cleanup; not live initialized logical demand.
fields.overflow: Checked multiplication/conversion before admission.

fields.name: ReservedBytes
fields.definition: Pending admitted bytes while reservation cleanup remains and backing is unprepared; zero after actual preparation, activation or completed return.
fields.overflow: Exact extent bounded by admitted domain capacity.

fields.name: OwnedBackingBytes
fields.definition: Actual associated backing still retained by this same control, including activated unique ownership and failed cleanup; zero only after return.
fields.overflow: Checked exact acquired extent, not history-derived.

fields.name: PeakOwnedBackingBytes
fields.definition: Largest real associated extent successfully installed in this fixed-shape control; failed backend acquisition cannot invent a peak.
fields.overflow: Exact immutable acquired extent.

fields.name: BackingIsPrepared
fields.definition: Readiness completed at least once, including zero length. Stays true after activation and return, not a current live-backing gauge.
fields.overflow: Sticky successful readiness marker.

fields.name: ReservationMoveCount
fields.definition: Authority publications before activation only; later unique movement does not increase this count.
fields.overflow: Exactly derived from checked non-wrapping authority version.

fields.name: BackingPreparationFailureCount
fields.definition: Actual backend or post-acquisition observation preparation failures for this control, not domain aggregate.
fields.overflow: Saturating control history with HistoryOverflowed.

fields.name: HasReservationReturnObligation
fields.definition: Pending/prepared reservation resource has not returned and activation has not transferred its responsibility to unique ownership; failed terminal cleanup preserves true.
fields.overflow: Exact lifecycle gauge independent of histories.

fields.name: ReturnFailureCount
fields.definition: All actual same-control payload/resource return failures, including subsequent unique cleanup, unlike admission-domain reservation-only failures.
fields.overflow: Saturating control history with sticky flag.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.definition: At least one control failure history exceeded exact Int64 capacity; not the budget-domain flag.
fields.overflow: Sticky; exact authority/gauges do not saturate.

fields.name: ControlFieldBytes
fields.definition: Base unique fields plus three Int64, one Int32 and one Boolean reservation-only fields. Excludes CLR headers, padding, referenced objects and derived layout fields.
fields.overflow: Fixed structural sum independently checked on actual declared fields.

schemas.scope: One unique acquisition control observed through one binding. Full associated page/segment extent is not additive across occupants and a return event is not necessarily physical free.
schemas.consistency: Individual volatile/control and allocator fields are sampled, not a cross-owner transaction. Capture conveys no new authority; quiescent boundaries reconcile.
schemas.resetPolicy: No reset. Lineage, binding version, authority, peaks and histories survive successful return on non-default values. Default values throw rather than fabricating a snapshot.
schemas.historyOverflow: Failed-return history saturates with sticky flag; moves derive from checked non-wrapping authority. Current gauges are exact.

fields.name: OwnerId
fields.definition: Stable backing owner lineage: direct owner or originating allocator, not address.
fields.overflow: Construction checks non-wrapping owner identity.

fields.name: AllocationId
fields.definition: Allocation lineage paired with OwnerId; direct controls use owner identity, pooled controls use their allocation identity.
fields.overflow: Non-wrapping acquisition identity; never address-based.

fields.name: BindingVersion
fields.definition: This value's fixed version, so a stale alias remains distinguishable after movement.
fields.overflow: Published binding version never wraps.

fields.name: AuthorityVersion
fields.definition: Actual control publication version; activation can begin unique ownership at a version greater than one.
fields.overflow: Checked move exhausts/cleans up without wrap.

fields.name: BindingIsActive
fields.definition: This exact binding and its allocator accept unique authority in active state, with payload not returned.
fields.overflow: Exact boolean unaffected by history saturation.

fields.name: Lifecycle
fields.definition: Actual active, moving, returning, retiring, returned, finalizing, invalidated or shared cleanup-custody control state; not physical backing state or unique access permission.
fields.overflow: Finite lifecycle without terminal resurrection.

fields.name: ActiveBorrowCount
fields.definition: Actual unique bounded-operation admissions, excluding shared lifetime pins and failed borrow attempts.
fields.overflow: Operation admission guards bounded count before overflow.

fields.name: PeakBorrowCount
fields.definition: Recorded maximum simultaneous successful unique borrow entries; retained after return. Sharing custody preparation does not invent a unique borrow.
fields.overflow: Exact maximum of guarded admission count.

fields.name: MoveCount
fields.definition: Current non-wrapping authority minus unique publication's initial version; reservation moves are excluded by specialized control.
fields.overflow: Exact derivation, not saturated history; ordinary controls subtract one.

fields.name: LiveUniqueOwnerCount
fields.definition: One while control and allocator accept a unique publication, otherwise zero; stale aliases are not extra owners, and shared cleanup custody is not unique authority.
fields.overflow: Exact zero-or-one gauge.

fields.name: HasReturnObligation
fields.definition: Control return is incomplete even when allocator authority was revoked or consumed control is retiring.
fields.overflow: Exact completion state independent of histories.

fields.name: InitializedPayloadBytes
fields.definition: Initialized logical range while allocator authority, shared cleanup custody or an entered unique borrow retains the payload; specialized unactivated reservation has no initialized payload. Shared and transfer lineage observations describe the same storage, not additive quantities.
fields.overflow: Int32 length times unmanaged size in Int64; not additive across aliases.

fields.name: PeakInitializedPayloadBytes
fields.definition: Original fully published initialized logical extent, surviving return; specialized reservation reports zero before activation.
fields.overflow: Exact immutable initialized extent.

fields.name: OwnedBackingBytes
fields.definition: Complete known NAM-owned backing associated with the uncompleted obligation, including pooled shared page slack; not domain total or physical free credit.
fields.overflow: Checked actual acquired extent.

fields.name: BorrowedBackingBytes
fields.definition: Complete registered provider extent associated with uncompleted obligation; separate from owned storage and budget. Public unique creators currently acquire owned storage.
fields.overflow: Checked provider extent; no invented backend events.

fields.name: PeakOwnedBackingBytes
fields.definition: Original complete acquired associated extent, including pooled page slack, retained after authority return; provider-backed peak is genuinely zero.
fields.overflow: Exact fixed acquired extent, no reconstructed lifetime peak.

fields.name: PayloadReturnCount
fields.definition: One only after actual successful return, including empty or reusable pooled payload; not necessarily a physical native free.
fields.overflow: Exact zero-or-one completion gauge.

fields.name: PayloadReturnFailureCount
fields.definition: Failed real return attempts, not validation refusals or entered borrows preventing an attempt.
fields.overflow: Saturates with HistoryOverflowed; obligation remains exact.

fields.name: HistoryOverflowed
fields.definition: Sticky exactness flag for this control's failed-return history; not its budget or process flag.
fields.overflow: Sticky while authority and ownership remain exact.

fields.name: ControlFieldBytes
fields.definition: All unique control fields plus specialized reservation fields where applicable. Excludes CLR headers, padding and referenced storage; not a heap-size promise.
fields.implementation: NativeTransfer.cs#ControlFieldBytes = 3L * IntPtr.Size + 6L * sizeof(long) + 6L * sizeof(int) + 2L * sizeof(bool) + Unsafe.SizeOf<NativeBlock>()
fields.overflow: Fixed architecture-dependent structural sum independently reflection-checked.
